title: Does anyone else dream of a big football field?
content: Not sure if this is the right place to ask. I see a lot of people referencing the mall or school "world" with slight variations. Lately, the past couple years or so, I keep dreaming of a giant football field connected to these places. Only it's like the football field that has been converted to a town? There are small buildings outside, like little stores and things. I can tell it was a football field because of the super green, short (likely fake) grass with the white marks on it, and around the whole place is a stadium with bleachers where people would normally sit. In the dream though, people are wandering around the field. I don't think anyone sits in the bleachers, they are just there to keep everyone inside. I guess it makes sense that this is connected to the "school world" since high schools typically have football fields. This one massive though, and like I said, has been converted into a town. Can anyone relate?
